classification_policy.true_positive: The first valid scanner finding mapped to a ground-truth issue.
classification_policy.false_negative: A ground-truth issue with no valid scanner detection.
classification_policy.false_positive: An unmapped finding counted as incorrect.
classification_policy.duplicate_match: An additional finding mapped to a ground-truth issue already detected.
classification_policy.ambiguous_match: A finding with inconsistent or incomplete mapping information.

false_negatives.classification_reason: No scanner finding matched this ground-truth issue.

ground_truth.title: Multi-source COPY destination does not end with a slash
ground_truth.rationale: COPY instructions with multiple source paths require an unambiguous directory destination. Ending the destination with a slash makes that intent explicit and avoids invalid or misleading build instructions.
